I'm a product manager specializing in AI/ML platforms and agentic AI systems. I sit at the intersection of product strategy and ML engineering — and I've done it at scale, not in theory.

## What I Do

I lead **AI Platform at [Smartly](https://www.smartly.io)** — one of the world's largest ad-tech platforms — where I'm shipping Agent Harness, AI Applications, ML Foundation, and MLOps infrastructure. This is enterprise-scale agentic AI, running in production, today.

In parallel, I'm co-founding **[MimixLabs](https://mimixlabs.ai)** with [Navid Ghayazi](https://navid-ghayazi.web.app/): behavioral simulation for AI-native product development. Our Behavioral Identity Persona (BIP) engine is validated against 42M+ events and 1.4M+ users with 73.9% behavioral similarity vs. real humans. We simulate how users behave before you build.

## Track Record

Before this, I spent 3+ years as **Staff PM for AI/ML Platform at [HelloFresh](https://engineering.hellofresh.com)** — responsible for the platform that powers all data science across the business.

| What | Result |
|---|---|
| ML models in production | 4 → **70** |
| Annual revenue from ML | **$25M+** |
| MAU growth | **400x** |
| Model time-to-production | 3 months → **1 month** |
| Data science teams served | **8+** |

I built the MLOps infrastructure, the feature store, the Operational Readiness Checklists (ORC), and the observability and drift monitoring stack that made this possible — alongside the data science teams shipping the models.

Earlier in my career I co-founded **IT Leaders** (acquired 2012), giving me founder DNA alongside operator depth. I also hold an MSc in Software Engineering from [Politecnico di Torino](https://www.polito.it/), which means I can read code and sit in rooms with engineers without needing a translator.

## Why I Write

Most content about AI in the enterprise is either theoretical or promotional. I write to fill the gap: operational, specific, earned.

The things I care about:
- Why AI projects fail before they generate €1 (and how to prevent it)
- What MLOps actually means when you have 70 models in production
- How to build agentic AI systems that don't collapse under real workloads
- What "AI-native product development" means beyond the buzzword
